money-and-cost.cash_card_notes: Cash declaration: Bermuda Customs requires a Customs Traveller Declaration for accompanied personal cash or negotiable instruments above BDA$10,000 (or the foreign-currency equivalent); no declaration is needed at BDA$10,000 or less. Cash that isn't accompanied personal money, and any cash sent by post, courier or cargo, goes on a Bermuda Customs Declaration in any amount. Cash declarations can't be lodged electronically. On US-precleared flights, more than US$10,000 also needs the US currency reporting form.
